summary: Harden the Host-owned reviewer admission chain without adding any new authority: provider-observed model attestation (missing/mismatch fail closed), admission policy digest frozen at start and re-validated at mint/cache/consume/joint-batch/derived grants, model-chain exhaustion never clamps back to the same unauthorized model, and a real deadlock fix in review_terminal_current (direct map read under the held lock instead of a nested Lock re-acquire). Also fix full_test stale-grant replay across worktrees/commands by binding the exact canonical target before reusing a frozen review base, with actionable fail-closed diagnostics.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing HostReviewAdmission, SubAgentRunner, LLMClient and settings/factory wiring
components.disposition: REUSE the existing HostReviewAdmission authority, SubAgentRunner process-local attestation and operator-configured model chain. No new reviewer identity, approval path or admission bypass: observed_model comes only from the provider wire, policy digest binds the already-frozen operator configuration, and entitlement exhaustion fails closed. The #68 fix filters existing full_test grants by canonical workdir+command before replay; it never mints, broadens, or self-approves a qualification.

components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Reviewer observed model comes from the provider response only; absence, multi-valued or mismatched identity denies the PASS at mint and again at consume, so a spoofed or silent model swap cannot mint or spend a grant. If the runner cannot attest (restart, pruned handle), admission fails closed with reviewer_model_unattested.

g1.necessity: The current chain trusted the runner's requested model label as reviewer identity, allowed policy drift between start and consume, and could retry the same unauthorized model after entitlement exhaustion; a non-reentrant lock also deadlocked the mint path. Provider-observed identity, frozen policy digest, strict chain advancement and the lock fix are directly verifiable fail-closed properties. A full_test grant frozen for a different worktree/command could replay its stale base and misleadingly report full_test_no_delta; exact-target filtering fixes that without relaxing review authority.

g2.authority_owner: Existing HostReviewAdmission review gate, SubAgentRunner in-process attestation and operator-configured reviewer model chain
g2.non_duplication: Strengthen the single existing admission authority; no second reviewer path, no new approval channel, no reuse-window or Host-admission bypass is introduced.
